ATP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ATP 9.6 mM

ADP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ADP 0.56 mM (Table 1)

Pi.data_reference: amin1995dual; cytoplasmic Pi of E. coli near 10 mM in typical growth (BioNumbers BNID 105540, from Amin & Peterkofsky 1995 and Rao & Torriani 1994); 20-30 mM in carbon-starved cells

J_demand_in.data_reference: no pool connected (an open sum port is 0)

Q_prot_max.data_reference: derived: proteolysis_capacity x the amino acids in the resting cell's proteins (sum of n_0 L over its pools) (proteolysis_capacity: willetts1967intracellular, placeholder; proteome_per_um3: milo2010bionumbers, sourced; L_proteome: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder)

Q_eps.data_reference: definitional; numerical floor, 1e-9 amino acids/s (13 orders below the proteases' capacity)

N_aa_init.data_reference: definitional; no recycled amino acids at rest

K_aa.data_reference: derived: aa_reuse_K x cell volume x N_A (aa_reuse_K: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder)

tau_aa_cat.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; time constant with which recycled amino acids the cell does not reuse are catabolised (deaminated and their carbon fermented or excreted); 30 min assumed

y_aa_cat.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; ATP a fermenting cell makes per amino acid catabolised: 1 per arginine by the arginine deiminase pathway, about 1 for serine, threonine or alanine through pyruvate to acetate, none for most others without respiration; 0.5 assumed as the mean

J_ref.data_reference: derived: maintenance_coefficient x cell volume ^ maintenance_exponent (Lynch & Marinov at 20 C) (maintenance_coefficient: lynch2015bioenergetic, sourced; maintenance_exponent: lynch2015bioenergetic, sourced)

build_capacity_rest.data_reference: derived: ribosomes x k_elong x ribosome_active_fraction x (c_syn + c_poly) / N_A / the resting ATP turnover (ribosomes_per_um3: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder; k_elong: farewell1998effect, sourced; ribosome_active_fraction: dai2016reduction, sourced; c_syn: akashi2002metabolic, placeholder; maintenance_coefficient: lynch2015bioenergetic, sourced)

x_ribo.data_reference: definitional; the resting ribosomes (used when unconnected)

ATP_floor.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; ATP at which building protein and growth stop (stringent response); full speed at the resting ATP

ATP_ref.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ATP 9.6 mM

J_eps.data_reference: definitional; numerical floor, 1e-30 mol/s (12 orders below the resting turnover)

A_mem.data_reference: geometry: in-plane membrane of the 2 um cell

surface_factor.data_reference: derived: (2 pi R^2 + 2 pi R h)/(2 pi R h): a disc's whole surface over its rim (R_cell: unreferenced_placeholder, design; h_cell: unreferenced_placeholder, design)

area_max_fraction.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; most of the cell surface the adaptable proteins may take (placeholder; membrane proteins cover 30-50% of a bacterial membrane, transporters part of that)
